description: Moves one Gmail message to Trash. Takes the message ID. The message leaves the inbox and every other label view and stays in Trash, where Gmail deletes it for good after 30 days; gmail_untrash restores it before then. Returns the message ID and the labels the message carries afterwards. Acts on the one message named, not on the rest of its thread.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

message_id.description: The ID of the message to move to Trash, as gmail_search, gmail_list and gmail_read return it.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_trash
